x: Our first team,made up of Shippen, Black, Walker, Robinson, Stearman and Moore wandered between thirteenth and ninth before settling in tenth place- a position far below their capabilities.
A few weeks later we travelled to West Bromwich for the National, without such stars as Newell (unfit) Bhatia and Moore; both of whom are ineligible for birth reasons.
Forey 12:48 Hart 14:06 Smart 13:47 Shippen 12:58 Penny 13:37 Moore 13:36 Johnstone 13:05 D.Newell 14:39 Asten 14:25 Beaumont 15:30

Heck, Miller, Thresher, Moore and Johnston are but a few knocking on the door to 1st team honours. There are also those up-and-coming lads Cocks, Hampshire and Fairclough who will be dis-placing a few old-timers before long.

We hope that by then we have Bill Kerr Ron Linstead and Alan Black back with us, and also see such people as Miller Moore and our up-and-coming Juniors making competition for those coveted team positions really hot.
After all, how is this for a depleted ten? - Black, Brown, Barrow, Kerr, O'Hara, Newell, Bicourt, Thorpe, Moore and Walker. It would be an even greater feat to win both trophies!
